notes.title: Patch 1.2.5 - December 28 2018
notes.notes:
Hello!

New in 1.2.5:


 The game now runs on the new version of Unity.
 The game now weighs less almost twice.

 Add. Level number when loading the game.
 Add. "Select Level" in main menu.

 Fix. System overload due to textures.
 Fix. Performance improvement.
 Fix.Bugs.



Thank you for your support and feedback! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - October 28 2017
notes.notes:
Hello!
New in 1.0.5:


 Added. No more level loading when the character falls.
 Added. Three difficulty types (Easy, Normal and Hard).
 Added. Checkpoints (Only Easy difficulty)
 Added. Hidden events for the holidays.

 Fix. Stability of the game.
 Fix. Improved FPS on some levels.
 Fix. Portal. Problem with effects.

 And more small changes.


Thank you for your support and feedback! ːsteamhappyː
